paper_statement: Geo-NeW enforces Dirichlet boundary conditions exactly, producing zero error at boundary nodes independent of learned weights.
source_anchor: main.tex, Section 4.4 Table 3; Appendix boundary-basis construction
assumptions: Boundary degrees of freedom use the paper's constrained parameterization.
The distance/mask factor is exactly zero on Dirichlet nodes.

checks: constrained boundary max absolute error is at numerical roundoff
the result holds for seeded worst-case random network weights
an unconstrained network produces a detected nonzero violation

rejection_rule: Any constrained boundary error above tolerance or a negative control that does not violate the boundary exits nonzero.
